_comment: What to watch and who to tell. Everything is explained in README.md. After editing, run: python3 zelda_watch.py --check-config

notifications._people: Everyone who can get alerts. Topics are secrets and never go in this file: with one person, use the NTFY_TOPIC repository secret; with several, use one NTFY_TOPICS secret holding JSON such as {"julie": "topic-one", "sam": "topic-two"}.
notifications._status_alerts_to: Who gets the heartbeat, self-test results and 'watcher problem' warnings.
notifications._discord: Optional Discord alerts through a channel webhook (the link goes in the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL secret). A product with a 'topic' pings that topic's role; see README.md, 'Discord alerts'. status_alerts also posts the heartbeat and warnings.

_approved_stores: Stores you are willing to buy from; links to any other store are skipped. Built in: nintendo, bestbuy-ca, amazon, walmart, ebgames. Add your own under custom_stores. Walmart and EB Games block GitHub's servers, so their links are only checked when the watcher runs on a home connection.
_custom_stores: Stores not built in, for niche products. See README.md: 'Adding your own store'. Check a link with: python3 zelda_watch.py --check-link URL
_products: Each product is a name plus its link at every store you would buy it from. 'notify' is optional and defaults to everyone in notifications.people. A link can also be written as {"url": "...", "enabled": false} to pause it.

products.name: Zelda 40th Pro Controller + display stand (Nintendo exclusive)

_heartbeat: Send a quiet all-clear this often (hours), so silence is trustworthy. Set to 0 to disable.

politeness._comment: Minimum seconds between two requests to the same site, and how long to leave a site alone after it rate-limits us (HTTP 429) if it does not say how long.

self_test._comment: Nintendo items that are normally in stock. Running the workflow with self_test ticked checks these with the real checker and sends a real push, proving detection and delivery work end to end. The heartbeat repeats it. Only one needs to be in stock to pass.

discovery._comment: Alerts when a NEW matching product page appears on the Nintendo store in 'region'. Other regions' sitemaps are scanned too, because the CA sitemap lags. With auto_watch, newly found products are then stock-watched automatically.

_migrate_from_v1: One-time map from the old per-target ids in state.json to links, so switching formats does not re-send alerts. Safe to delete after the first run on this format.
